uniqueness_method.comparison_scope: the other eight focus-site top masks only; this is not a complete registry certification
uniqueness_method.directed_dot_overlap: fraction of candidate positive pixels within 3 raster pixels of reference positive pixels
uniqueness_method.correlation: absolute Spearman rank correlation on the binary surfaces
uniqueness_method.interpretation: Any one pair crossing either threshold fails uniqueness. The owner audit reports every listed top mask fails against at least one other focus-site mask.
